items.source: Use an array results. More efficient if we know how many results to expect.
items.translation: 使用数组结果。如果我们知道预期的结果数量，这种方法更高效。

items.source: mapRow in interface RowMapper<T extends @Nullable Object>
items.translation: `mapRow` 接口中的 `RowMapper<T extends @Nullable Object>`

items.source: Implementations must implement this method to map each row of data in the ResultSet. This method should not call next() on the ResultSet; it is only supposed to map values of the current row.
items.translation: 实现类必须实现此方法，以映射 `ResultSet` 中的每一行数据。此方法不应调用 `ResultSet` 的 `next()`；它仅用于映射当前行的值。

items.source: Implementation of RowMapper that calls the enclosing class's mapRow method for each row.
items.translation: 实现调用外围类的mapRow方法的每一行的 RowMapper。

items.source: Implementations must implement this method to map each row of data in the ResultSet.
items.translation: 实现必须实现此方法，以映射 ResultSet 中的每一行数据。

items.source: rs - the ResultSet to map (pre-initialized for the current row)
items.translation: rs - 要映射的 ResultSet（已针对当前行预初始化）

items.source: SQLException - if an SQLException is encountered while getting column values (that is, there's no need to catch SQLException)
items.translation: SQLException - 如果在获取列值时遇到 SQLException（即无需捕获 SQLException）。

items.source: rowNum - the number of the current row
the result object for the current row (may be null)
items.translation: 当前行的结果对象（可能为null）

items.source: Rod Johnson, Thomas Risberg, Jean-Pierre Pawlak
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Thomas Risberg 和 Jean-Pierre Pawlak
